questions.q: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) projects a dataset from \( \mathbb{R}^{30} \) onto its top \( 2 \) principal components. What is the dimension of each transformed data point?
questions.answer: PCA projection onto \( k \) eigenvectors transforms each sample vector from \( \mathbb{R}^D \) to \( \mathbb{R}^k \). Here \( k = 2 \), so the reduced dimension is \( 2 \).
